{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Identify QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99')
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Remove QA orders from the filtered group
filtered_clean = filtered[~filtered.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Compute conversion rate on clean group
n_total_clean = len(filtered_clean)
n_converted_clean = filtered_clean['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_clean = n_converted_clean / n_total_clean

# Now, explicitly print only the numbers that will be in the evidence
# (as required by the system — even if we've run it before)
print(n_total_clean)
print(n_converted_clean)
print(conversion_rate_clean)"}
